ops.text: IV Licensee may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, in which case Licensor shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination, and no early termination fee or other penalty shall be payable by Licensee. Licensor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Initial Period or any extension thereof.

input.comment: [Playbook] Article IV commits us to a 36-month term with no ability to exit for convenience, so we have added a 30 days' notice convenience right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and confirmed the Licensor has no matching right during the term. If helpful, we can move to 60 days' notice.
input.summary: Add Licensee termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with prepaid-fee refund; bar Licensor convenience termination during the term.
